text:
[Council File 26-1233]
[Items for which Public Hearings Have Not Been Held - (10 Votes Required for Consideration)]
PUBLIC SAFETY COMMITTEE REPORT AND BUDGET AND FINANCE COMMITTEE REPORT relative to the creation of a new Los Angeles County Fire Department Participating Agency Oversight Fee for the Hazardous Waste Program.
Recommendation(s) for Council action:
APPROVE the creation of a Los Angeles County Fire Department Participating Agency Oversight Fee, and add the new fee to the Department's Cost of Special Services for Certified Unified Program Agency (CUPA) Programs.
Fiscal Impact Statement:
The Board of Fire Commissioners reports that the proposed fee will be incorporated into the Unified Program Fee and assessed on all 7,508 current hazardous waste facilities within the City. The fee will be approximately $136.51 per facility and is projected to generate approximately $1,024,966 in additional CUPA permit revenue in Fiscal Year 2026-27 to offset staff time and resources allocated to oversight of the Hazardous Waste Program. Neither the City Administrative Officer nor the Chief Legislative Analyst has completed a financial analysis of this report.
Community Impact Statement:
None submitted
